title: Participation (PNL)
subtitle: PNL is a participation and coordination token used inside the PonyLife ecosystem to account for delegated rights, conditional involvement, and platform-level experimentation — not an investment product.

sections.heading: What PNL represents
sections.body: PNL represents conditional participation within the PonyLife ecosystem. It is used to account for delegated commercialization and participation rights associated with creative assets and to coordinate interactions between creators, promoters, and the platform.

sections.heading: Why PNL is allocated
sections.body: When a creative asset is submitted, the platform may perform an internal, experimental assessment for coordination purposes. Based on this assessment, a corresponding amount of PNL may be reserved or allocated to the creator to reflect their participation within the system.

sections.heading: PNL and asset realization
sections.body: Until an asset is realized, allocated participation units remain conditionally associated with the creator’s participation. When realization occurs, economic outcomes are handled by the platform, and the creator retains their allocated PNL, which becomes freely usable within or outside the ecosystem.

sections.heading: What PNL is not
sections.body: PNL does not represent equity, ownership in PonyLife, or a claim to guaranteed financial returns. It is not designed as a security, yield instrument, or price-backed asset, and its use is limited to participation and coordination logic.

sections.heading: Risk and uncertainty
sections.body: Participation involves uncertainty. Outcomes depend on market response, coordination effectiveness, and experimental conditions. PonyLife does not guarantee results and does not promote speculative behavior.
